description: A routing box for playing along with a recording: a stereo performance signal is passed out to the recording, and Audition takes it off the recording and folds it into what you monitor instead

params.text: Scales the Click input into both monitoring outputs, 0 for silent and 1 for the voltage as it arrives; it comes up at 1
Holds Audition at full while it is lit; the Audition input adds to it, and either setting is faded in and out over about 10ms

inputs.text: One side of the performance signal; Audition crossfades it from the Record Bus output on that side to the monitoring output on that side
One side of the sound coming back from the recording chain, added to the monitoring output on that side at the voltage it arrives at
Raises Audition, 0V for none and 10V for full, added to whatever the Audition button is set to and held at full above that
A click track, added to both monitoring outputs at the level the Click knob sets, and never passed to the Record Bus

outputs.text: One side of what you monitor: the Record Monitor input on that side, plus the Click input at the Click knob's level, plus the performance signal on that side scaled by Audition
One side of what reaches the recording: the performance signal on that side, faded down to silence as Audition comes up

notes: the maker marks this module hidden in the plugin's manifest, so it does not appear in the module browser and reaches a patch only by being copied from one that already has it
every jack is monophonic; one voltage is read and one written on each, and a polyphonic cable is reduced to its first channel
bypassing the module passes each performance input straight to the Record Bus output on its side, and each Record Monitor input straight to the monitoring output on its side
the red lamp follows the faded Audition level, and the lamp in the button shows only whether the button itself is latched

inputs.4:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
